scope: World-side binding of the opcode-21 movie table (scripts/lol2/movie_table.json) to the port's players. 'player' is the script that already stages and plays that movie through its own owner; 'none' means no player exists yet: the host still stages the request and the world side logs which movie it would be (opcode21_movie adapter, docs/DEVIATIONS.md). Only names an Act 1 command references are listed; every other table entry is 'none' by default.
